contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ D N VALENTINIANVS P F AVG ; R/ REPARATIO REI PVB

A Roman copper alloy nummus of Valentinian II (375-392), dating to c. AD 378 to 383. D N VALENTINIANVS P F AVG, diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. SMNB in exergue. Nicomedia. Reece Period 20. Obverse inscription: D N VALENTINIANVS P F AVG. Obverse description: Pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Reverse inscription: REPARATIO REI PVB. Reverse description: Emperor, head left,…
